import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize_scalar
y=dP_dt; V=np.var(y)
def fit(c, Tlist, Plist):
    g=np.tanh(c*t)
    T={'1':np.ones_like(t),'g':g,'t':t,'gt':g*t,'g2':g*g,'t2':t*t}
    names=[(a,k) for a in Tlist for k in Plist]
    X=np.vstack([T[a]*P**k for a,k in names]).T
    cc=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)[0]
    return np.mean((y-X@cc)**2)/V, names, cc
r=minimize_scalar(lambda c: fit(c,['1','g','t','gt'],range(4))[0], bounds=(0.1,0.4), method='bounded')
c0=r.x; print('c',c0)
nm,names,cc=fit(c0,['1','g','t','gt'],range(4))
for n,v in zip(names,cc): print(n, round(v,5))

    r=minimize_scalar(lambda c: fit(c,Tl,Pl)[0], bounds=(0.1,0.4), method='bounded')
    print(Tl,list(Pl), '%.3e'%r.fun, round(r.x,4))
